full_judgment: 21. In the facts and circumstances of the case and in the light of the discussion above, we are of the view that the court of appeal and the trial court on proper consideration and correct assessment of the materials on record arrived at a correct decision and the High Court Division without adverting to the reasoning’s given by the appellate court and trial court and without considering the materials on record in their proper perspective reversed the concurrent findings of fact of the two courts below although there was no misreading and non-consideration of evidence by the two courts below and as such the impugned of the High Court Division cannot be said to be a proper judgment of reversal. Therefore, the impugned judgment requires interference by us.
